title: Prophylactic Anti-aRrhythmic therapy with Amiodarone in critically ill patients admitted for an out-of-hospital Cardiac Arrest with initial shockable rhythm._PARACA
official: Prophylactic Anti-aRrhythmic therapy with Amiodarone in critically ill patients admitted for an out-of-hospital Cardiac Arrest with initial shockable rhythm._PARACA
summary: Main objective: To comparatively determine if prophylactic administration of amiodarone for 72 hours in critically ill patients admitted after an OHCA with shockable rhythm, with a confirmed or a presumed cardiac cause, decreases the incidence of a composite endpoint of 30-day (starting from inclusion) all-cause mortality and/or severe in-hospital ventricular arrhythmia recurrence (ventricular fibrillation and/or ventricular tachycardia requiring intervention including re-arrest)
conditions: Out-of-hospital cardiac arrest with initial shockable rhythm

interventions.name: CORDARONE 150 mg/3 ml, solution injectable en ampoule (IV)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patient aged ≥ 18 years
2. Admitted in intensive care unit
3. Out-of-hospital cardiac arrest with shockable rhythm
4. Presumed cardiac or unknown cause
5. Delay between ROSC and screening for randomisation < 6 hours
6. Informed consent from the patient or a surrogate or deferred consent
7. Affiliated to or benefiting from a social insurance
Exclusion criteria:
1. Cardiac arrest secondary to an extra-cardiac cause (suspected or confirmed)
2. Need for veno-arterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VA-ECMO) at admission
3. Known limitations in therapy and Do Not Resuscitate-order
4. Patient with known amiodarone long –term treatment
5. Patient already included in a clinical trial (other than observational clinical trials)
6. Moribund patient due to pre-arrest history (estimated life expectancy < 3 months)
7. Pregnant or breastfeeding women
8. Indication for amiodarone decided by the physician at ICU admission
9. Foreseeable inability to obtain secure venous access for the administration of amiodarone
10. Known or suspected hyperthyroidism
11. History of cardiac conduction disorders, not treated by permanent pacemaker
12. Amiodarone allergy
13. Refractory ventricular arrhythmia or electrical storm
